high.title: Ibovespa Below 180,000 Points: Is There Still Room for Gains in the Stock Market?
high.summary: The Ibovespa has experienced a significant correction in early May, falling 4% in the first seven trading sessions and dropping below 180,000 points on Tuesday (12th) - a level not seen since March. This represents a notable reversal from April's strong performance, when the index closed with 16% gains year-to-date and nearly reached 200,000 points. According to Empiricus Research equity analyst Ruy Hungria, the recent decline reflects a more challenging macroeconomic environment driven by reduced risk appetite in the local market. A key factor behind the selloff is rising global inflation expectations, with higher inflation in the US and other major economies pressuring central banks toward more aggressive monetary tightening. This environment creates headwinds for Brazilian equities as investors reassess risk positions. The correction raises important questions about the sustainability of the Brazilian stock market rally and what investors should expect going forward.

medium.title: Bitcoin (BTC) Loses $80,000 Support with Deteriorating Inflation; See Crypto Prices This Thursday (14)
medium.summary: Bitcoin fell below $80,000 support, trading around $79,000 with a 1.5% decline in 24 hours. The broader crypto market retreated as investors reacted to worsening US inflation data, with the Producer Price Index rising 1.4% quarterly and 6% annually - the highest since 2022. This signals corporate cost pressures are being passed to consumers amid geopolitical tensions. The inflation data reinforces expectations for more aggressive central bank policies globally, creating headwinds for risk assets including cryptocurrencies.
